brand_draft_scope_check.name: brand_draft_scope_check
brand_draft_scope_check.value: ("brand_draft"."scope" = 'new' and "brand_draft"."base_revision" is null) or ("brand_draft"."scope" <> 'new' and "brand_draft"."base_revision" is not null and "brand_draft"."base_revision" > 0)

brand_purge_step_check.name: brand_purge_step_check
brand_purge_step_check.value:
"brand_purge"."step" between 0 and 3
    and (("brand_purge"."step" = 3 and "brand_purge"."completed_at" is not null and "brand_purge"."issue" is null)
      or ("brand_purge"."step" < 3 and "brand_purge"."completed_at" is null))

user_data_export_scope_check.name: user_data_export_scope_check
user_data_export_scope_check.value: "user_data_export"."requested" between 1 and 3 and "user_data_export"."included" between 0 and 3 and ("user_data_export"."included" & "user_data_export"."requested") = "user_data_export"."included"

user_data_export_fingerprint_check.name: user_data_export_fingerprint_check
user_data_export_fingerprint_check.value: ("user_data_export"."included" = 0 and "user_data_export"."fingerprint" is null) or ("user_data_export"."included" <> 0 and "user_data_export"."fingerprint" is not null and length("user_data_export"."fingerprint") = 64)

quota_attempt_cost_check.name: quota_attempt_cost_check
quota_attempt_cost_check.value:
"quota_attempt"."upper_minor" >= 0 and (
    ("quota_attempt"."state" in ('pending', 'unknown') and "quota_attempt"."actual_minor" is null and "quota_attempt"."reconciled_at" is null) or
    ("quota_attempt"."state" = 'known' and "quota_attempt"."actual_minor" is not null and "quota_attempt"."actual_minor" >= 0 and "quota_attempt"."reconciled_at" is not null)
  )

quota_grant_limits_check.name: quota_grant_limits_check
quota_grant_limits_check.value:
"quota_grant"."kind" in ('sampling', 'generation') and "quota_grant"."action" in ('set', 'revoke')
    and "quota_grant"."version" > 0 and "quota_grant"."count_limit" > 0 and "quota_grant"."budget_minor" >= 0 and length("quota_grant"."currency") = 3

quota_reservation_state_check.name: quota_reservation_state_check
quota_reservation_state_check.value:
"quota_reservation"."upper_minor" >= 0 and (
    ("quota_reservation"."state" = 'reserved' and "quota_reservation"."finalized_at" is null) or
    ("quota_reservation"."state" in ('settled', 'released') and "quota_reservation"."finalized_at" is not null)
  )

fact_version_state_check.name: fact_version_state_check
fact_version_state_check.value:
("brand_fact_version"."state" IN ('draft', 'pending_confirmation') AND "brand_fact_version"."confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "brand_fact_version"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "brand_fact_version"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("brand_fact_version"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "brand_fact_version"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND
      (("brand_fact_version"."state" = 'approved' AND "brand_fact_version"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("brand_fact_version"."state" = 'revoked' AND "brand_fact_version"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)))

capability_version_values_check.name: capability_version_values_check
capability_version_values_check.value:
"capability_version"."version" > 0
    and "capability_version"."status" in ('candidate', 'verified', 'degraded', 'disabled')
    and "capability_version"."reason" in ('initial-record', 'verification', 'significant-change', 'disable', 'restore', 'expiry-review')
    and "capability_version"."citation_capability" in ('complete', 'partial', 'unsupported')
    and "capability_version"."search_required" in (0, 1) and "capability_version"."public_visible" in (0, 1)
    and (
      ("capability_version"."status" = 'verified' and "capability_version"."verified_at" is not null and "capability_version"."expires_at" is not null)
      or ("capability_version"."status" <> 'verified' and "capability_version"."public_visible" = 0)
    )

sampling_answer_network_values_check.name: sampling_answer_network_values_check
sampling_answer_network_values_check.value:
"sampling_answer_network"."requested_network_mode" in ('on', 'off', 'unknown')
    and "sampling_answer_network"."actual_network" in ('true', 'false', 'unknown')
    and "sampling_answer_network"."trigger_evidence" in ('none', 'observed')
    and "sampling_answer_network"."qualifies_required_search" in (0, 1)

monitoring_attempt_state_check.name: monitoring_attempt_state_check
monitoring_attempt_state_check.value:
"monitoring_attempt"."ordinal" between 1 and 20 and "monitoring_attempt"."synthetic" in (0, 1) and "monitoring_attempt"."late" in (0, 1)
    and "monitoring_attempt"."transport" in ('isolated', 'official_api')
    and (("monitoring_attempt"."transport" = 'isolated' and "monitoring_attempt"."synthetic" = 1) or ("monitoring_attempt"."transport" = 'official_api' and "monitoring_attempt"."synthetic" = 0))
    and ("monitoring_attempt"."currency" is null or length("monitoring_attempt"."currency") = 3)
    and ("monitoring_attempt"."upper_minor" is null or "monitoring_attempt"."upper_minor" >= 0)
    and (
      ("monitoring_attempt"."cost_state" in ('none', 'pending', 'unknown') and "monitoring_attempt"."actual_minor" is null)
      or ("monitoring_attempt"."cost_state" = 'known' and "monitoring_attempt"."actual_minor" is not null and "monitoring_attempt"."actual_minor" >= 0)
    )
    and (
      ("monitoring_attempt"."kind" = 'sampling' and "monitoring_attempt"."ordinal" <= 3 and "monitoring_attempt"."disposition" in ('pending', 'adopted', 'safe_failure', 'unknown', 'late'))
      or ("monitoring_attempt"."kind" = 'analysis' and "monitoring_attempt"."disposition" = 'analysis_reuse' and "monitoring_attempt"."cost_state" = 'none')
    )

monitoring_run_scope_check.name: monitoring_run_scope_check
monitoring_run_scope_check.value:
"monitoring_run"."track" in ('model_api', 'consumer_ui')
    and "monitoring_run"."repeat_count" between 1 and 3
    and "monitoring_run"."question_count" > 0 and "monitoring_run"."natural_count" between 0 and "monitoring_run"."question_count"
    and "monitoring_run"."channel_count" > 0 and "monitoring_run"."slot_count" = "monitoring_run"."question_count" * "monitoring_run"."channel_count" * "monitoring_run"."repeat_count"
    and length("monitoring_run"."region") = 2 and length("monitoring_run"."language") between 2 and 40
    and "monitoring_run"."requested_network_mode" in ('on', 'off', 'unknown')
    and "monitoring_run"."status" in ('queued', 'running', 'paused', 'succeeded', 'partial', 'failed', 'cancelled')
    and "monitoring_run"."sampling_complete" in (0, 1) and "monitoring_run"."customer_payable_minor" = 0
    and (("monitoring_run"."status" in ('queued', 'running', 'paused') and "monitoring_run"."sampling_complete" = 0)
      or "monitoring_run"."status" in ('succeeded', 'partial', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
    and (
      ("monitoring_run"."track" = 'consumer_ui' and "monitoring_run"."currency" is null and "monitoring_run"."upper_minor" is null and "monitoring_run"."estimate_high_minor" is null)
      or ("monitoring_run"."track" = 'model_api' and "monitoring_run"."currency" is not null and length("monitoring_run"."currency") = 3
        and "monitoring_run"."upper_minor" >= 0 and "monitoring_run"."estimate_high_minor" = "monitoring_run"."upper_minor" * "monitoring_run"."slot_count")
    )

monitoring_slot_state_check.name: monitoring_slot_state_check
monitoring_slot_state_check.value:
"monitoring_slot"."natural_question" in (0, 1) and "monitoring_slot"."repeat_index" between 1 and 3
    and "monitoring_slot"."channel_version" > 0 and "monitoring_slot"."late" in (0, 1)
    and "monitoring_slot"."status" in ('queued', 'running', 'paused', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'reconciliation_required')
    and (("monitoring_slot"."status" = 'succeeded' and "monitoring_slot"."adopted_attempt_id" is not null)
      or ("monitoring_slot"."status" <> 'succeeded' and "monitoring_slot"."adopted_attempt_id" is null))

answer_analysis_state_check.name: answer_analysis_state_check
answer_analysis_state_check.value:
"answer_analysis_version"."version" > 0 and "answer_analysis_version"."entity_version" > 0
    and "answer_analysis_version"."mentioned" in ('true', 'false', 'unknown')
    and "answer_analysis_version"."recommended" in ('true', 'false', 'unknown')
    and "answer_analysis_version"."official_site_cited" in ('true', 'false', 'unknown')
    and "answer_analysis_version"."status" in ('pending', 'classified', 'needs_review', 'revised')
    and ("answer_analysis_version"."revised_from" is null or "answer_analysis_version"."revised_from" <> "answer_analysis_version"."id")

answer_observation_state_check.name: answer_observation_state_check
answer_observation_state_check.value:
"answer_observation"."source_mode" in ('model_api', 'consumer_ui')
    and "answer_observation"."capture_method" in ('official_api', 'manual', 'assisted', 'isolated')
    and "answer_observation"."citation_set_state" in ('complete', 'partial', 'unsupported', 'missing')
    and "answer_observation"."evidence_state" in ('draft_evidence', 'complete', 'incomplete', 'contested')
    and "answer_observation"."entity_version" > 0 and length("answer_observation"."fingerprint") = 64
    and length("answer_observation"."region") = 2 and length("answer_observation"."language") between 2 and 40
    and "answer_observation"."requested_network_mode" in ('on', 'off', 'unknown')
    and (
      ("answer_observation"."evidence_state" = 'draft_evidence')
      or ("answer_observation"."evidence_state" in ('complete', 'incomplete', 'contested') and length("answer_observation"."answer_text") > 0)
    )
    and (
      ("answer_observation"."source_mode" = 'consumer_ui' and "answer_observation"."capture_method" in ('manual', 'assisted'))
      or ("answer_observation"."source_mode" = 'model_api' and "answer_observation"."capture_method" in ('official_api', 'isolated', 'assisted'))
    )

optimization_finding_state_check.name: optimization_finding_state_check
optimization_finding_state_check.value:
"optimization_finding"."gap_type" in ('fact_error', 'name_confusion', 'key_content_missing', 'page_unreadable', 'citation_gap', 'needs_evidence')
    and "optimization_finding"."assumption_level" in ('observed_absence', 'verified', 'pending')
    and "optimization_finding"."business_importance" between 1 and 3
    and "optimization_finding"."estimated_effort" between 1 and 5
    and "optimization_finding"."verified_evidence" in (0, 1)
    and "optimization_finding"."privacy_risk" in (0, 1)
    and length("optimization_finding"."question_cluster") > 0
    and length("optimization_finding"."target_page") > 0

optimization_task_state_check.name: optimization_task_state_check
optimization_task_state_check.value:
"optimization_task"."gap_type" in ('fact_error', 'name_confusion', 'key_content_missing', 'page_unreadable', 'citation_gap', 'needs_evidence')
    and "optimization_task"."status" in ('todo', 'doing', 'blocked', 'implemented', 'retest_pending', 'closed', 'dismissed')
    and "optimization_task"."priority_bucket" in ('urgent', 'normal')
    and ("optimization_task"."manual_rank" is null or "optimization_task"."manual_rank" > 0)
    and (
      ("optimization_task"."status" = 'dismissed' and "optimization_task"."dismiss_reason" is not null)
      or ("optimization_task"."status" <> 'dismissed')
    )
    and (
      ("optimization_task"."manual_rank" is not null and "optimization_task"."reorder_reason" is not null)
      or ("optimization_task"."manual_rank" is null)
    )

page_check_state_check.name: page_check_state_check
page_check_state_check.value:
"page_check_record"."public_status" in ('reachable', 'restricted', 'pending_verification', 'not_applicable')
    and "page_check_record"."contains_executable_instructions" in (0, 1)
    and length("page_check_record"."url") > 0
    and length("page_check_record"."normalized_url") > 0

content_asset_state_check.name: content_asset_state_check
content_asset_state_check.value:
"content_asset"."kind" in ('cover', 'inline', 'other')
    and "content_asset"."visibility" in ('public', 'internal')
    and "content_asset"."review_status" in ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')
    and length("content_asset"."content_ref") > 0
    and length("content_asset"."fingerprint") > 0

content_delivery_package_state_check.name: content_delivery_package_state_check
content_delivery_package_state_check.value:
"content_delivery_package"."kind" in ('formal', 'review')
    and "content_delivery_package"."do_not_reuse" in (0, 1)
    and "content_delivery_package"."non_publishable" in (0, 1)
    and ("content_delivery_package"."kind" = 'review' or ("content_delivery_package"."non_publishable" = 0 and "content_delivery_package"."approval_id" is not null))
    and length("content_delivery_package"."manifest_json") > 1
    and length("content_delivery_package"."files_json") > 1
    and length("content_delivery_package"."package_fingerprint") > 0

content_version_state_check.name: content_version_state_check
content_version_state_check.value:
"content_version"."status" in ('draft', 'in_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'invalidated')
    and "content_version"."labeling_profile_status" in ('verified', 'unverified')
    and length("content_version"."target_channel") > 0
    and length("content_version"."labeling_profile_version") > 0
    and length("content_version"."image_asset_ids_json") > 1
    and length("content_version"."fact_version_ids_json") > 1
    and "content_version"."template_kind" in ('fact_faq', 'scenario_solution', 'verifiable_comparison')
    and length("content_version"."title") > 0
    and length("content_version"."body_markdown") > 0
    and length("content_version"."claims_json") > 1
    and length("content_version"."fingerprint") > 0
